identitySignals: Name matches: the agenda's 'Diablo Roofing, Inc.' (Oakland, CA) is the same name and city shown on the company's own website and on its BBB profile (10227 International Boulevard, Oakland, CA 94603)

OUSD's Board file for the Westlake Middle School Gym Roof Replacement lists the contractor as Diablo Roofing, Inc. (Oakland, CA), and the company's website describes commercial roofing, matching OUSD's 'School buildings & construction' contract

The company website and the BBB profile give the same address and phone number, and BBB lists a founding date of June 23, 2020, which matches the business start date shown on BuildZoom for the same Oakland address and phone

profile.summary: Diablo Roofing is a roofing contractor based in Oakland, California. It installs, repairs and replaces roofs and does waterproofing work for commercial and multifamily buildings in Northern California.

review.notes: Diablo Roofing, Inc. of Oakland, CA matches the OUSD Legistar record (Westlake Middle School gym roof replacement, Oakland CA) and the company site and BBB agree on name, address and phone.
